title: HNM four-site quantitative stability certificate
feedback: AM1 rejects direct numerical-source transfer. The advisor adopts the panel's proposed generic creation-majorant route, explicitly rederived for support four and onsite gap one.
model: Every finite I1 complete-factor volume with the original selected-strip/free-link onsite reference, full whole-star omitted interactions, actual ground centering and endpoint gauge actions. Fixed alpha,hbar,E_star>0. Both signs of tau.
required: Independently derive every proposed coefficient and support count; reject candidate if unjustified
Actual creation decomposition, fixed-point map, ball self-map and Lipschitz constant including scalar energy
Complete centered excited-sector resolvent exclusion, not just vacuum fixed-point construction
Gauge covariance of onsite ground and construction; physical ground and nonzero physical sector
Compact spectral onsite cutoffs respecting ground/gauge, uniform estimates and full untruncated domain/min-max or resolvent passage
Every volume with actual boundary interactions, no global infinite-volume bounded unitary assumption
Exact certified exponential bounds, equality and zero-source controls, omitted diagonal/scalar and support-three wrong controls
acceptance: Admit a uniform finite-volume full-model numerical gap only if the complete analytic implication is proved and independently checked. Algebraic substitution into an unproved majorant is insufficient. Retain partial/insufficient verdict if any premise fails.
scope_limit: This is an alternative quantitative finite-volume theorem, not evaluation of Yarotsky's named c1/c2. Infinite-volume state selection, local limits, AN's separate constants, continuum matching and field construction are not automatic consequences.
attribution: Candidate constants and route are shared advisor/panel proposals. Standard creation-expansion methods and external sources retain authorship; scientific priority remains unverified.
